LanguageData.CA_LoreBook_Opening: The Marked Virus does not raise the dead. It leaves the living with their skills, their memories, and a new appetite that turns both into weapons. The first mistake is to think that recognition means mercy.
LanguageData.CA_LoreBook_ResearchNote: Field records show several possible endings to infection: transformation, collapse, or rare resistance. Progress is usually swift, but no clock is reliable enough to replace quarantine and care.
LanguageData.CA_MilitaryReport_01: Military Report 01: Infected subjects can use weapons, doors, cover, and scavenged equipment. Their behavior varies by role and leader. Do not mistake a pause, a familiar voice, or a damaged weapon for surrender.
LanguageData.CA_MilitaryReport_02: Military Report 02: Packs form a rough hierarchy around Alphas and useful specialists. Removing a leader can disrupt coordination, but it may also provoke a sudden, reckless attack. Plan for both outcomes.
LanguageData.CA_SurvivorJournal_01: Survivor Journal: One of them remembered the route to our shelter. Another remembered my name. I still cannot decide which detail frightened me more.
LanguageData.CA_AudioLog_01: Audio Log C-44: A cross-shaped rash may appear as infection advances. Its timing and severity vary. A clean face is not proof of safety, and the mark does not tell you what the person will do next.
LanguageData.CA_PlanetaryTimeline: Field timeline: first exposure, uncertain symptoms, rapid transformation or collapse, scattered survivors, organized packs, contested settlements, and new communities formed under the mark.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_MessageCured: {0} has been cured of the Marked Virus and has recovered.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_MissingCure: Warning: You don't have a cure to administer.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_NotInfected: {0} is not infected with the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_OperationNotInfected: not infected with the Marked Virus
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_MessageCureStarted: The cure is working through {0}. It will take effect in a few minutes.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_NeedsCureInInventory: {0} needs a cure syringe in their inventory to inject the cure.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_InjectCureGizmoDesc: Inject a cure syringe carried in this pawn's inventory into an infected pawn.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_MessageBloodDrawn: Drew an infected blood sample from {0}.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_NoRoomForSample: There is no room to place the infected blood sample.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_NeedsSyringeInInventory: {0} needs a syringe in their inventory to draw blood.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_DrawBloodGizmoDesc: Draw blood from an infected pawn using a syringe carried in this pawn's inventory.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Intro: Use presets for a quick difficulty pass, or tune each section directly. Editing any field changes the active preset to Custom.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PresetHelp: Presets rewrite the schedule, enemy mix, virus behavior, AI pressure, story UI, and performance settings at once.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_CasualTip: Slower raids, lower exposure risk, smaller hordes, and more immune survivors.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_VanillaLikeTip: Keeps the faction dangerous while staying closer to ordinary RimWorld pacing.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_DefaultTip: Restores the intended baseline tuning for the mod.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_BrutalTip: Faster, harder, less forgiving raids with stronger infection pressure.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_OutbreakTip: Large outbreak pressure with faster spread, larger hordes, and faster reanimation.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_VeryEasyTip: Slower raids, lower exposure risk, smaller hordes, and more immune survivors.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_EasyTip: Keeps the faction dangerous while staying closer to ordinary RimWorld pacing.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_NormalTip: Restores the intended baseline tuning for the mod.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_HardTip: Faster, harder, less forgiving raids with stronger infection pressure.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_Preset_VeryHardTip: Large outbreak pressure with faster spread, larger hordes, and faster reanimation.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectColonistsDesc: When enabled, your own colonists can be infected by the Marked Virus. Disable to make colonists immune to new infections.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectAlliesDesc: When enabled, allied, neutral, and guest pawns can be infected by the Marked Virus. Disable to protect non-hostile non-colonists.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectEnemiesDesc: When enabled, hostile pawns like raiders can be infected by the Marked Virus. Disable to prevent the virus from spreading to enemy factions.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_TemporaryAllyDuration: How long infected victims remain controlled in the playable Marked Men scenario before returning to the Marked Men. With Ideology active they are slaves, not colonists; without Ideology, RimWorld treats player-controlled pawns as colonists. Range: 1–365 days.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VariantsOnlyInRaidsDe: When enabled, specialized infected variants (Watcher, Pursuer, Gunner, Raveger, Soldier, Breaker, Arsonist, Alpha, Overlord, The Marked One) only appear during raids and incidents, not in faction settlements or world spawns.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RaidScheduleDesc: Controls when Marked Men incidents appear and how hard scheduled attacks scale.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnemyMixDesc: Controls which infected pawn types appear. Weight 0 disables that type; weight 1 is normal; higher values make that type more common. Specialists also become more common as raid points rise, while elites stay capped per raid.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_civilianWeightMultipl: Basic infected with improvised weapons. The most common type.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_scoutWeightMultiplier: Fast reconnaissance infected with light weapons.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_shooterWeightMultipli: Ranged infected with sidearms and SMGs.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raiderWeightMultiplie: Experienced violent infected with mixed gear.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_soldierWeightMultipli: Former military infected with military-grade gear.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_bruteWeightMultiplier: Heavy melee infected. Usually appears only when raid points are high enough.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_alphaWeightMultiplier: Elite command infected that strengthens nearby Marked Men.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_warlordWeightMultipli: Regional commander infected. Rare and extremely dangerous.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedManWeightMultip: Ultimate infected. Endgame encounter, extremely rare.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VirusAndCorpsesDesc: Controls exposure chances, infection timing, terminal outcomes, and infected reanimation.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_CA_MarkedTurned_Stren: Scales the base stat modifiers applied to pawns transformed by CA_MarkedTurned hediff. Higher values make transformed victims stronger.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedTurnedMoveSpeed: Multiplier for transformed pawn movement speed (0.5 = 50% slower, 1.5 = 50% faster).
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedTurnedMeleeAccu: Flat bonus to melee hit chance for transformed pawns (0.1 = +10% melee accuracy).
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedTurnedRangedAcc: Flat bonus to shooting accuracy for transformed pawns (0.05 = +5% shooting accuracy).
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedTurnedHealthReg: Amount of health restored per tick interval (0.001 = slow regeneration over time; 0 = no regen).
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedTurnedFatiguePa: Fatigue recovery rate per tick (-0.001 = fatigue recovers faster; 0 = fatigue unchanged).
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedTurnedIncomingD: Multiplier for damage taken (0.8 = 20% damage reduction, 1.2 = 20% more damage taken).
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedTurnedMeleeCool: Multiplier for melee attack speed (0.9 = faster attacks, 1.1 = slower attacks).
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedTurnedPainFacto: Multiplier for pain experience (0 = no pain felt, 1 = normal pain, -1 = pain suppressed even if injured).
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AIStorytellingDesc: Controls Marked Men pressure logic, strategic AI activation thresholds, storyteller integration, raid countdown warnings, and custom story events.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PerformanceCapDesc: Controls maximum simultaneous infected, cleanup intervals, reanimation processing, world pawn tracking limits, and performance optimization settings.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UrbanBiomeDesc: Controls Marked Men presence in urban maps: ambush frequency, dormant infestation density, epicenter encounters, and survivor spawn chances.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UINotificationsDesc: Controls which messages, alerts, letters, gizmos, and info cards the mod shows in the user interface.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_ResetTip: Reset all settings to their default values.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_CoreDesc: Global switches for infection and compatibility diagnostics. These do not remove existing hediffs from a save.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AllowNewInfectionsDes: When disabled, this mod stops creating new Marked Virus exposure events. Existing infections continue to run normally.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LogCompatibilityMods: Log detected compatibility mods on load
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LogCompatibilityModsD: Writes a short compatibility scan to the RimWorld log after loading. Leave this off unless you are troubleshooting.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnableWarbandsDesc: Allows the main timed Marked Men raids that escalate over the colony timeline.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnableHordesDesc: Allows larger moving horde events in addition to the main warband schedule.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnableProbesDesc: Allows small scouting packs that test the colony before larger attacks arrive.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RandomizeRaids: Randomize raid timing and arrival patterns
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RandomizeRaidsDesc: Adds uncertainty to raid intervals and arrival modes. Disable this for predictable testing or calmer pacing.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_firstMarkedRaidDayDes: When did the infection begin? The chronometer flickers. The Marked will come when they are ready.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedRaidFrequencyMu: Master multiplier for warbands, hordes, and probes. Set this to 0 to stop all scheduled Marked Men incidents.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_warbandFrequencyMulti: Multiplier for main warband raids after the global multiplier is applied.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_hordeFrequencyMultipl: Multiplier for horde events after the global multiplier is applied.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_probeFrequencyMultipl: Multiplier for small probe incidents after the global multiplier is applied.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VehicleAssaultsDesc: Configure the Marked Men vehicle raid types. These assaults require Vehicle Framework and eligible vehicles in the Marked Men faction.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LandRaidVehiclesDesc: Choose which installed ground vehicles may appear in land assaults. Only vehicles in enabled categories and selected here can be used.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AirRaidVehiclesDesc: Choose which installed aircraft may appear in airborne assaults. Only vehicles in enabled categories and selected here can be used.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_CombinedLandRaidVehic: Choose ground vehicles specifically for combined-arms assaults. This selection is independent of the land-only assault selection.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_CombinedAirRaidVehicl: Choose aircraft specifically for combined-arms assaults. This selection is independent of the airborne-only assault selection.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VehicleCategoriesDesc: Vehicle categories apply to every vehicle raid. Military (Combat) vehicles are enabled by default; other categories must be enabled here and selected in the relevant vehicle list.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VehicleFrameworkNotLo: Vehicle Framework is not loaded, so no vehicle definitions can be selected.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_NoRaidVehicles: No compatible raid vehicles from loaded mods were found for this category.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VehicleDefaultDisable: Disabled by default; enable its category and select it to include this vehicle.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VehicleUseDefaultsDes: Restore the default vehicle choices for this raid type.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VehicleSelectAllDesc: Select every compatible vehicle listed for this raid type. The enabled category filters still apply.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VehicleSelectNoneDesc: Disable every vehicle for this raid type. The dedicated raid will not launch unless at least one compatible vehicle is enabled.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LandVehicleAssaultsDe: Allow scheduled Marked Men raids to use ground vehicles.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AirborneVehicleAssaul: Allow scheduled raids that deploy aircraft with an infantry assault.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_CombinedArmsAssaultsD: Allow scheduled raids combining a ground vehicle assault with aircraft support.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_vehicleAssaultFrequen: Scales the chance of each enabled vehicle assault relative to other Marked Men incidents. Set to 0 to disable all vehicle assaults.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VehiclePassengerDisem: Disembark surplus passengers when raid vehicles enter a configured combat range.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LandVehicleDisembarkR: Distance to the nearest colony target before land-vehicle passengers disembark.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AirVehicleDisembarkRa: Distance to the nearest colony target before helicopter passengers disembark.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VehicleEmergencyDamag: Passenger evacuation threshold based on remaining vehicle hit points; crew remains aboard.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidPointsMultiplierD: Applies once to the storyteller's current threat-point estimate (which tracks colony wealth and difficulty), after escalation and the minimum floor. Final pawn counts remain limited by the per-raid and active-raider caps.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_minimumRaidPointsDesc: Point floor for generated Marked Men attacks. Higher values make even early raids larger.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maximumRaidPointsDesc: Hard point ceiling for generated Marked Men attacks. Prevents extreme late-game raids from exceeding this value.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidEscalationPerRaid: Extra raid strength added after each scheduled warband starts.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidEscalationMaxBonu: Maximum accumulated escalation bonus from repeated warbands.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidEscalationRandomn: Range of randomization around expected raid escalation (0 = predictable, 1 = ±100% variance). Breaks predictability while maintaining overall difficulty curve.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidDifficultyWavines: Occasional difficulty dips between strong raids (0 = no dips, 1 = 100% reduction on alternating raids). Creates pacing variety.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidEscalationSpikePr: Chance per raid for a sudden 1.5x difficulty spike (0 = never, 1 = always spike). Cannot spike twice in a row.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_GroupedEdgeArrivalsDe: Allows raiders to enter together from one map edge.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SplitGroupEdgeArrival: Allows several groups to enter from different edge positions.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_ScatteredEdgeArrivals: Allows a wider scattered edge arrival pattern.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SingleEdgeArrivalsDes: Allows single-file edge entry when the incident worker selects it.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_minimumHordeSizeDesc: Smallest horde size when a horde incident does not request a specific count.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maximumHordeSizeDesc: Largest horde size after threat scaling and variance.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_minimumProbeSizeDesc: Smallest scouting pack size when the incident does not request a specific count.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maximumProbeSizeDesc: Largest scouting pack size after threat scaling and variance.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maximumAlphasPerRaidD: Hard cap for alpha infected in generated raids. Set to 0 to prevent alphas from spawning.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_bloodExposureChanceDe: Chance that infected blood exposure creates a Marked Virus exposure event.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_infectedAssaultExposu: Chance that direct infected assault contact creates a Marked Virus exposure event.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_closeContactExposureC: Chance per valid nearby target during a contagion pulse from an infected pawn.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_infectionProgressionS: Higher values make the disease advance faster. Lower values give victims more time.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_incubationDurationMul: Multiplies infection stage durations before progression speed is applied.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_immunitySurvivalChanc: Chance that a terminal infection ends in lasting immunity instead of transformation or viral death.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_terminalTransformatio: Relative weight for becoming one of the Marked Men when immunity does not save the pawn.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_terminalDeathWeightDe: Relative weight for dying from viral collapse when immunity does not save the pawn.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_TerminalOutcome: Current terminal outcome after the immunity roll: {0} transform, {1} die.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_reanimationChanceDesc: Chance that a valid infected corpse transforms after death. No corpse remains.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_reanimationDelayTicks: Delay before queued infected corpses can transform. 60,000 ticks equals one in-game day.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_starterLineageBreakth: Chance that special starter-lineage resistance fails after direct exposure.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectionTransmission: Controls how the Marked Virus spreads through combat. Ranged transmission is disabled by default and can be enabled below. Explosions and turrets never transmit infection.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnableMeleeTransmissi: Master toggle for all melee-based infection transmission. When disabled, no melee attack can spread the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_BiteTransmissionDesc: When enabled, bite attacks from infected pawns can transmit the virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_biteInfectionChanceDe: Chance that a bite attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_ClawTransmissionDesc: When enabled, claw attacks from infected pawns can transmit the virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_clawInfectionChanceDe: Chance that a claw or stab attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_ScratchTransmissionDe: When enabled, scratch attacks from infected pawns can transmit the virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_scratchInfectionChanc: Chance that a scratch attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PunchTransmissionDesc: When enabled, punch and blunt attacks from infected pawns can transmit the virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_punchInfectionChanceD: Chance that a punch or blunt attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_MeleeWeaponTransmissi: When enabled, melee weapon attacks from infected pawns can transmit the virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_meleeWeaponInfectionC: Chance that a melee weapon attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_MarkedMenGuaranteedDe: When enabled, fully transformed Marked Men always infect on melee contact.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedMenInfectionCha: Chance that a fully transformed Marked One transmits the virus on melee contact. Used when guaranteed infection is disabled.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_EnableRangedTransmiss: When enabled, ranged attacks from infected pawns can transmit the Marked Virus. Disabled by default.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_rangedInfectionChance: Chance that a ranged attack from an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SealedApparelDesc: Toggling a category off removes full viral immunity for that apparel type, reverting to partial resistance instead.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_WarcasketsBlockDesc: When enabled, any warcasket torso shell provides full immunity to direct Marked Virus exposure. Disable this if you want warcasket pawns to still face infection risk.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_VacsuitBlockDesc: When enabled, wearing both a vacsuit body and helmet provides full immunity via the sealed combo. Disable to make the combo only give partial resistance.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_GasMasksBlockDesc: When enabled, gas masks, HAZMAT masks, and toxin-immune headgear provide full immunity. Disable for partial resistance only.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SealedArmorBlockDesc: When enabled, HAZMAT suits, sealed undersuits, security armor, and orbital armor provide full immunity. Disable for partial resistance only.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectedApparelCompat: Controls what apparel types infected pawns can equip. Category-based blocking for unique pawn behavior.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AllowTribalApparelDes: Allow infected pawns to wear apparel tagged as tribal, such as tribalwear and tribal headgear. Disable to keep infected in non-tribal clothing.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AllowNeolithicApparel: Allow infected pawns to wear apparel tagged as neolithic, such as early leather and bone gear. This is separate from the tribal tag.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AllowMilitaryApparelD: Allow infected pawns to wear apparel with industrial or spacer military tags, including flak and most combat armor.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AllowScoutApparelDesc: Allow infected pawns to wear apparel tagged as scout or skirmisher gear. Useful for mods that add light reconnaissance clothing.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AllowPoweredArmorDesc: Allow infected pawns to wear powered armor such as recon, marine, cataphract, and similar suits. When disabled, powered armor is blocked even if military apparel is allowed.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AllowShieldsDesc: Allow infected pawns to wear energy shield belts and other shield apparel.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AllowHelmetsDesc: Allow infected pawns to wear headgear in the Overhead layer. Disabling this blocks helmets, hats, and masks regardless of other category settings.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AllowApparelWithTagsD: Allow apparel with tags that do not match the tribal, neolithic, military, or scout categories. This mainly covers clothing added by other mods. Disabling it only blocks those uncategorized tagged items; the category toggles above still apply.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_BloodlustSystemDesc: Enables the Marked Bloodlust need. Infected pawns build bloodlust through fighting and killing, then lose it over time when idle.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_bloodlustDecayRateDes: How quickly the Bloodlust need drains when an infected pawn is not fighting. Higher values drain faster.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_bloodlustKillGainMult: Multiplier applied to Bloodlust gained when an infected pawn kills a victim.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_bloodlustCombatGainMu: Multiplier applied to Bloodlust gained while an infected pawn is in combat.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_KillAnticipationDesc: Enables the Kill Anticipation hediff, which rewards infected pawns for pursuing and eliminating targets.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_anticipationGainMulti: Scales how quickly Kill Anticipation builds when infected pawns engage their prey.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_anticipationDecayMult: Scales how quickly Kill Anticipation fades when infected pawns lose their target.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_InfectedAIDesc: Controls how infected pawns choose targets, use doors and cover, and pressure the colony. These settings affect performance as well as behavior.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_TacticalRetargetingDe: Allow infected pawns to periodically re-evaluate their target and switch to a better one.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PriorityTargetingDesc: Let infected pawns prioritize high-value and vulnerable colony targets such as isolated pawns and undefended structures.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_DoorTargetingDesc: Allow infected pawns to attack doors and barriers that block their path into the colony.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_infightingChanceDesc: Chance per infighting check that infected pawns in the same pack turn on each other. Set to 0 to disable infighting.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_infightingCheckInterv: How often the mod checks whether infected pawns should fight each other. 60,000 ticks equals one in-game day.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_socialTerrorStrengthD: Scales how strongly the Marked Men's presence spreads fear and panic among colonists.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_MarkedPanicEnabledDes: Enable panic hediffs on nearby colonists when infected pawns attack.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedPanicRadiusDesc: Radius in cells around infected attacks where panic can be applied.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_markedPanicDurationTi: How long Marked panic lasts. 60,000 ticks equals one in-game day.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PredatoryInstinctsDes: Controls bloodlust buildup, kill anticipation, and the aggression bonuses infected pawns gain from combat and kills.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_MessagesAndDevToolsDe: Controls raid warnings, notification detail, incident logging, and the mod's debug actions.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RaidCountdownDesc: Show an on-screen countdown for the next scheduled Marked Men raid.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidCountdownVisibleD: Hide the countdown until the raid is this many days away. Set to 999 to keep it visible for the whole schedule.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_raidCountdownHighPrio: Display the countdown in red when the raid is this many days away. Set to 0 to disable the high-priority color.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_DetailedLettersDesc: Use longer incident letters with threat estimates and arrival details instead of short summaries.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_IncidentLogDesc: Write Marked Men incident activity to the game log for troubleshooting and review.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_DebugActionsDesc: Allow the Marked Men entries in the developer actions menu. Disable this if you want to prevent accidental debug raids.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_CaravanAmbushTimerDes: Controls the warning timer shown before Marked Men ambush a travelling caravan.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_caravanAmbushTimerVis: Display the caravan ambush countdown while a caravan is at risk.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_caravanAmbushTelegrap: How many days before a caravan ambush the warning timer appears.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_caravanAmbushPrepTime: Hours between the final ambush warning and the attack. Higher values give the player more time to react.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PerformanceDesc: Controls processing intervals and population caps. Raise intervals or lower caps if large raids cause lag.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_minRaidVehiclesDesc: Minimum number of vehicles generated in a vehicle raid. Must not exceed the maximum allowed raid vehicles.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maxAllowedRaidVehicle: Absolute ceiling for vehicles in any raid configuration. Cannot be set below the minimum raid vehicles.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maxContagionTargetsPe: Maximum number of nearby pawns that a single prisoner-contact contagion pulse can expose. Set to 0 to disable prisoner contact exposure.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_tacticalRetargetInter: How often infected pawns re-evaluate targets. Lower values react faster but cost more performance.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_lordCleanupIntervalTi: How often abandoned or invalid infected lords are cleaned up.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_infectedStateMaintena: How often infected pawns are checked for missing hediffs, tattoos, and other required state. Higher values reduce overhead.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_reanimationProcessInt: How often queued infected corpses are processed for transformation.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maxPendingReanimation: Maximum number of queued corpses processed in a single reanimation pass. Lower this if many simultaneous deaths cause lag spikes.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maxRaidInfantryDesc: Maximum number of non-vehicle infected pawns in a single raid.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maxRaidVehiclesDesc: Maximum number of vehicles actually spawned during a vehicle raid. Clamped between the minimum and maximum allowed values.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_maxActiveRaidPawnsDes: Maximum number of Marked Men pawns allowed on the map during an active raid. Additional spawns wait until the count drops.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UrbanOutbreakDesc: Controls Marked Men presence in urban maps, including ambushes, dormant infestations, epicenters, and survivor encounters.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UrbanOutbreaksDesc: Allow Marked Men outbreak incidents to occur in urban maps.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_urbanInfectionDensity: Scales how many infected pawns and infestation sites appear in urban maps. Higher values are more dangerous.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_urbanAmbushFrequencyD: Scales how often Marked Men ambush incidents trigger in urban maps.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_DormantInfestationsDe: Allow dormant Marked infestations to wait inside urban maps and activate later.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantInfestationFre: Scales how often dormant infestations are placed in urban maps.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_CityEpicentersDesc: Allow large infected epicenters to form in ruined urban areas.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_epicenterSpawnChanceD: Chance that an urban map generates with an infected epicenter.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_UrbanAmbushesDesc: Allow Marked Men ambush incidents in urban maps.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SurvivorEncountersDes: Allow uninfected survivor encounters in urban maps.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_survivorEncounterChan: Chance that an urban map includes a survivor encounter.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_AURSpawnProtectionDes: Controls where Marked Men may spawn in Ancient Urban Ruins maps so they do not appear directly on top of the player's starting area.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SpawnProtectionDesc: Prevent Marked Men from spawning too close to the player's starting position in Ancient Urban Ruins maps.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_aurMinimumSpawnDistan: Minimum distance in cells from the player's starting area for protected Ancient Urban Ruins spawns.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PreferEdgeSpawnDesc: Prefer spawning Marked Men near the map edge in Ancient Urban Ruins maps.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_SpawnDebugLoggingDesc: Write Ancient Urban Ruins spawn-protection decisions to the game log. Use only while troubleshooting.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LostSurvivorsDesc: Controls lost survivor events and dormant Mark carriers who may betray the colony after joining.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_LostSurvivorIncidents: Allow lost survivor encounters that can join the colony or carry a dormant Mark.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_lostSurvivorFrequency: Scales how often lost survivor incidents occur.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantMarkMinDaysDes: Minimum number of days before a dormant Mark can activate.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantMarkMaxDaysDes: Maximum number of days before a dormant Mark can activate.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantMarkTriggerMul: Scales how likely a dormant Mark is to activate when its trigger conditions are met.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantMarkAlphaChanc: Chance that a dormant carrier awakens as an alpha with escorts.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_dormantMarkGroupVaria: Chance that a dormant carrier awakens as part of a larger infected group.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_MarkedPrisonersDesc: Controls infection, restraint, self-harm, escape behavior, and cosmetic effects for infected prisoners.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PrisonerInfectionDesc: Allow infected prisoners to spread the Marked Virus to nearby pawns while imprisoned.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PrisonerRestraintDesc: Allow colonists to restrain infected prisoners, greatly reducing the risk of contact exposure and escape.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_prisonerInfectionChan: Chance that an infected prisoner exposes a nearby pawn during a contagion check.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PrisonerSelfHarmDesc: Allow infected prisoners to injure themselves as the infection advances.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_prisonerSelfHarmStage: Days of imprisonment before an infected prisoner begins self-harming.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_prisonerSelfHarmSuici: Days of imprisonment before an infected prisoner's self-harm becomes fatal.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_prisonerEscapeAggress: Scales how aggressively infected prisoners behave after escaping.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PrisonerCosmeticDesc: Allow cosmetic infection effects such as the crossed face tattoo on infected prisoners.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_prisonerEscapeChanceD: Chance per escape check that an infected prisoner attempts to break out.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_PrisonerDebugLoggingD: Write infected prisoner state changes to the game log. Use only while troubleshooting.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RJW_BridgeDesc: Optional bridge for RimJobWorld. Integration is only active when RJW is installed and both switches below are enabled.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RJW_AutoEnableDesc: Automatically enable the RJW bridge when RimJobWorld is detected.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_RJW_EnableDesc: Allow the Marked Men to participate in RJW systems. Requires RimJobWorld.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_Settings_rjwExposureChanceDesc: Chance that RJW contact with an infected pawn transmits the Marked Virus.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_RaidCountdownHUDTooltip: Estimated time until the next Marked Men raid: {0}.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_RaidCountdownHUDTooltipImminen: The next Marked Men raid is expected within the hour. Prepare defenses.
LanguageData.MarkedMen_RaidWarningLetterText:
A Marked Men attack is forming near {0}.

Estimated threat level: {1}.
Estimated arrival: {2}.

Use the remaining time to prepare defenses, stock medicine, and move vulnerable colonists to safety.
LanguageData.CA_LostSurvivor_Betrayal_Text: {PAWN} has fallen to the dormant Mark. The infection was waiting all along, and now another Marked Man walks among the colony's ruins.
LanguageData.CA_RestrainPrisonerDesc: Bind the infected prisoner to prevent escape and reduce contact exposure. Restrained prisoners are much less dangerous but cannot work.
LanguageData.CA_ReleasePrisonerDesc: Remove the prisoner's restraints. The prisoner becomes mobile again and the risk of contact exposure returns.
LanguageData.CA_MarkedPrisoner_RecruitBlocked: {PAWN} is a Marked prisoner and cannot be recruited while the infection holds.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_CuredRefugee_LetterBody: The cure has taken hold. {0} is lucid, no longer contagious, and has asked to remain with the colony.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_CuredRefugee_LetterFromFact: Before the infection, they were a member of {0}.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_CuredRefugee_Backstory: Before their infection, {0} was living a life we can barely imagine. Now, miraculously, they have been given a second chance.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_CuredRefugee_HealthStatus: Their current condition is at {0}% health.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_CuredRefugee_RequestToJoin: Accepting will gain a colonist but slightly upset their former faction. Letting them leave improves relations with that faction.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_MessageRefugeeRejected: {0} has been turned away and will leave the map soon.
